item.title: Galactic Events Studio: BCP and Melee.gg merge to unify tabletop gaming
item.description: Best Coast Pairings and Melee.gg have merged to form Galactic Events Studio, promising a unified platform for wargames and TCG events.

item.title: Ryan Dancey leaves AEG after claiming AI can design “as good” as humans
item.description: AEG COO Ryan Dancey has left the company after sparking a firestorm by claiming AI could design games like Tiny Towns and Cubitos.

item.title: Bikes are Magic: A creepy and cozy solo RPG about burnout and goats
item.description: Explore a magical village in Bikes are Magic: Goat Town. This creepy and cozy solo RPG uses a custom Exhaustion Engine to simulate burnout. Live on Kickstarter for ZineQuest.

item.title: Downcrawl and Skycrawl: Toolkits for Infinite Horizons
item.description: Generate strange underworlds and endless skies at your table. The Downcrawl and Skycrawl bundle offers system-agnostic toolkits for procedural tabletop roleplaying exploration.

item.title: Zatu Games ditches keyword domain for zatu.com in global rebrand
item.description: Zatu Games has moved from its board-game.co.uk domain to Zatu.com. We look at the international strategy behind the move and the technical glitches causing customer frustration.

item.title: Timothy Brown leads official Traveller 5e adaptation for BackerKit
item.description: The classic 1977 science-fiction roleplaying game Traveller is officially receiving a 5e conversion, launching on BackerKit this March.

item.title: Check out the latest wild trailer for crime thriller ‘Normal’ starring Bob Odenkirk
item.description: Magnolia Pictures just dropped the latest trailer for Normal, starring Bob Odenkirk - and it looks like it's going to be packed with action and gun-toting violence... with the occasional moose thrown in for good measure. It also looks like a whole lot of fun.

item.title: What is Jubensha? Anzir opens beta for heavily regulated script-based roleplaying games
item.description: Anzir is launching a public beta this February to bring Jubensha, a popular but heavily regulated Chinese script-based roleplaying format, to English-speaking gamers.

item.title: US board game industry eyes lengthy refund war following tariff decision
item.description: The US Supreme Court has ruled controversial global tariffs unlawful in a 6-3 decision, but American tabletop publishers view this as just the next battle in an ongoing war.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #349
item.description: A short month packed with TTRPG developments: We cover the passing of Patrick Campbell, the US board game tariff situation, and new releases like Skies Above. Explore the latest RPG tips and a curated summary of reviews and interviews.
